title: Settings
description: Your workspace, users and an overview of your data. You enter your own API keys (AI texts, newsletter sending) under <zugaenge>Own access keys</zugaenge>; your plan is under <billing>Plan & billing</billing>.

users.title: Users & roles
users.note: Every account has its own workspace, separated from other customers. You cannot add further users yourself yet.

system.title: System
system.dbNote: Number of entries stored in your workspace. You can export all data or delete the workspace below under "My data".

onboarding.title: Setup assistant
onboarding.description: The small step-by-step windows for AI providers, social platforms and voice output that appear the first time you open the app.
